import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] b = new long[20];

    static long recursive(long val, long depth) {
        long div = val / b[(int) depth];
        val %= b[(int) depth];
        if (val == 0)
            return div * depth;
        else
            return div * depth + Math.min(recursive(val, depth - 1),
                    depth + recursive(b[(int) depth] - val, depth - 1));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        for (int i = 1; i <= 17; ++i)
            b[i] = b[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long count_digits = 0, temp_n = n;
        while (temp_n != 0) {
            temp_n /= 10;
            ++count_digits;
        }
        System.out.println(recursive(n, count_digits + 2));
        sc.close();
    }
}
